implemented.feature: Independent PAGE, RESEARCH and POPUP states
implemented.details: Separate per-research EnumSet map. Presentation flag mutations never alter gameplay stages, discoveries, scans, inventory or currency. Completed addendum owners receive PAGE independently of existing RESEARCH.

Only opening a known browser node clears PAGE and RESEARCH. Search-result opens and ResearchPageScreen.parse/update do not clear them. Server acknowledgement validates living player, held Thaumonomicon and known catalog entry. No client flags or reward parameters are trusted.

implemented.feature: One-shot research popup snapshot and toast
implemented.details: Snapshot serializes POPUP and clears the server pending popup; the client queues one HUD toast then clears the local flag before updating the book. The original HUD artwork, icon path/position and five-second timer remain. Native-size wrapping, dynamic height/slots and repeated central frame strip are the requested font adaptation described in typography-audit.json; the original fitted fractional title is not retained.

Regular page requests suppress RESEARCH on the first completion in that request tree; this may be the KNOWLEDGETYPES sibling during FIRSTSTEPS start (POPUP remains). Later sibling completions retain RESEARCH. TERMINAL_NODE validates actual expected stage, stage>1 and terminal stage with identical requirements, and does not suppress completion notification. Five XP per successful catalog transition, zero on duplicate/failure/read. Siblings recurse with shared one-shot notification context.

implemented.evidence: PlayerKnowledge.java serialization stores enum names; previous port schema2 ui_seen markers were lossy
implemented.details: Schema3 stores research_flags separately, rejects old ui_seen as gameplay flags, uses silent restoration so reload does not replay notifications. UUID keyed SavedData retains progress across entity clone/reconnect. Schema2 exact current read marker is treated read; lower stage produces RESEARCH, increased eligible addenda produces PAGE. Never replay old POPUP because previous schema did not record delivery.

implemented.feature: Browser displays both flags and started research
implemented.details: Two independent node/category badges and hover labels. Category completion and search include known unfinished entries. Search categories match IDs, selected stage is min(length-1,stage+1), direct recipes only, result glyph UV224,48 and truncation label retained; click hitboxes exclude gaps/hidden rows. Search visibility persists while returning to browser.

implemented.evidence: GuiResearchBrowser.java:728-768 no open sound; GuiButton subclasses inherit vanilla button sound; unused clack helper814-815
implemented.details: Opening a node/search result is silent. Category/search buttons use vanilla UI_BUTTON_CLICK in MASTER. Named book sound helper uses LocalPlayer.playSound in PLAYERS with explicit volume/pitch, matching EntityPlayerSP.playSound; one-argument effective volume remains .25.

implemented.evidence: ResearchManager.java:189-198 sends tc.addaddendum with owning research localized title before PAGE notification
implemented.details: ResearchState queues transient owner-key completion events, independent of persistent PAGE. ResearchProgress sync/show delivers localized system chat then drains the queue. Codec does not restore these effects, so read acknowledgements and reconnect cannot replay old chat. No Player reference in ResearchState.

migration_limit: Schema2 stored combined read markers, so exact original independent unread history cannot be recovered. Migration preserves current-read markers and infers only demonstrable stage/addendum changes, without popup replay or gameplay reward.

Approved adaptation: preserve its first-completion behavior inside one server request tree, but never allow notification suppression to leak across requests or players.
